address: Carbis Bay Estate, Carbis Bay, St Ives, TR26 2NP, United Kingdom
bio: The words 'enviable location' could have been invented for Ugly Butterfly. With floor-to-ceiling windows that allow you take in the spectacular view across Carbis Bay over to Godrevy, it's a truly special spot. If counter dining is your thing, ask for a seat up at the open kitchen – don't worry, you will still see the views from here! The tasting menu is proudly local in its sourcing and is shot through with an original streak, while a low-waste mindset is exemplified by the terrific 'Wastage Snacks' to start and offcuts used as the basis for drinks, pickles and ferments....
